newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs mixed, propane steady amid slow activity.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs mixed, propane steady amid slow activity.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mixed midday Tuesday amid slow activity and little news, with propane values steady, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane traded at 34.75 cents a gallon. Sellers remained at Monday's level of 35 cents.
In the Midwest, Conway, Kansas, material held steady at 34.00/34.25 cents. Deals were made at 34.13 cents, traders said.
Players said the lack of news accounted for a sloppy market. "That's the problem with things today, there's not much news for people to hang their hats on," one trader said.

Meanwhile, players particularly in the Midwest were still digesting news of a small fire at National Cooperative Refinery Association's plant in McPherson, Kansas. The fire on Monday, which was confirmed by officials Tuesday, hobbled the gasoline-making unit at the 74,000 barrel-per-day refinery.
In the butane markets, Belvieu normal butane traded at 39.38 cents and a few times at at 37.75 cents in Conway.
